chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Hasan ibn Ali from Rifah said:
A man asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Is riding superior or walking?' He said: 'Riding is superior to walking because the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) rode.'

key_terms.صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: Peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: Is riding better than walking according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the superiority of riding over walking during Hajj by citing the Prophetic precedent (Sunnah) of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). This ruling reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on emulating the Prophet’s practical conduct as a primary source of legal and spiritual guidance, highlighting that ease and comfort in worship are meritorious when aligned with Prophetic tradition. The narration underscores the continuity between the Imams’ jurisprudence and the lived example of the Prophet, reinforcing the concept of *ittiba'* (following) in ritual practices.
